create_app: create and configure a FastAPI application with DeerFlow API Gateway including routers and lifespan handler
build_lifespan_handler: build an async lifespan handler that loads config, initializes LangGraph runtime, and starts channel service on startup
test_health_check: test the health check endpoint that returns service health status for deer-flow-gateway
summarize_create_app: summarize the create_app function that mounts 13 routers and registers the health check endpoint
review_app_instance: review the app instance created by create_app for use with uvicorn as the ASGI server
